hardening_changes: assets.py: provider paths reject Windows stream separators, reserved device names, control characters and trailing dots/spaces.
util.py: URLs with embedded credentials are rejected; malformed or negative Content-Length is refused; more credential headers redacted.
bounded_http.py: report-safe URLs mask userinfo and sensitive query values.
providers.py: provider-controlled error text is redacted before it can reach a caller.
limitations: The general urllib transport validates DNS before opening the connection; DNS rebinding between validation and connection is not prevented on that path. The bounded Gemini transport pins the resolved address instead.
Windows subprocess timeouts kill the direct child only; grandchildren may outlive the timeout and are not force-killed.
Archive extraction is not implemented, so archive traversal is not exercised.
